confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings, booking pages or price sources were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately certain. Alcohol prices are tax-driven and vary by venue, and hostel and hotel rates vary by season and district, so those are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are set relative to the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: General knowledge of Amman price levels relative to the wider Levant, not one named comparable city. Cocktail is about 2.1x the beer anchor and wine_glass about 1.75x, because direct bar-price knowledge is weak.
